$doc: §23.6 ST-2. Windows computed offline from UnitDetection.StepChance (PMax 0.9, EyeR50 400 m, Signature sqrt(men/9), a target standing still): steps = ceil(1/P(r)). Read from UnitDetections.Pairs.0.Reported (the observer's own level book); the contact-pool write (SquadCognitiveState.Contacts) is the same moment but needs SquadCognitiveState on the observer.

expect.name: a contact on the near target (150 m) appears inside N-1's window (2 steps +- 3 s)
a contact on the mid target (700 m) appears inside N-1's window (8 steps +- 3 s)
no contact on the far target (2500 m) - beyond the sensors' reach
